meta.title: AtomCode Second Opinion
meta.description: Spend your locally signed-in AtomGit's free quota on an independent code review: `atomcode_ask` is the model-side tool (its own tool loop — it decides which files to read); `/atomcode-review` is your one-click command for a diff self-check on uncommitted changes, a branch, or a PR. No API key, no model takeover.
